## Notes

- The root README should sell the project in 30 seconds.
- Keep it visual, concise, and GitHub/CV friendly.
- Link detailed explanations to `docs/` instead of overloading the root README.
- Use English as the canonical version and Spanish as a natural localized version, not a stiff literal translation.
